figurative_meaning_en: a small note, receipt, or acknowledgment slip
example_sentences_in_bangla: দোকান থেকে জিনিস কিনে হাত চিঠা নিয়েছি।
অফিসে আবেদনের সাথে হাত চিঠা জমা দিন।
example_sentences_in_english: I got a hand note after buying items from the shop.
Submit the application with an acknowledgment slip at the office.
note: Refers to informal or semi-formal written acknowledgments in Bengali bureaucratic and commercial contexts.
